item_verdicts.goal: the node goal is to make a ledger read over an unreadable run store raise naming the store and cause; reckon/run_store.py:686 stored_run_rows and :1648 indexed_run_ids now raise UnreadableRunStoreError with the store path and the cause for every measured shape.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it reports after 66 passed and base 58 passed, three negative-control mutations each red, and it discloses that the merge took origin/main's reckon/ledger.py, but its base-new-tests claim of 3 of 7 failing does not match logs/base-new-tests.log, which records 3 failed and 3 passed over a draft that names run_store.UnreadableRunStore.

justifications.durability: tests/test_an_unreadable_store_is_an_error.py:161 fails DID NOT RAISE when the query swallow is restored (logs/negative-control-a.log), :138 fails when a failed attach is passed over (negative-control-c.log), :186 fails when _refuse_owed_migration returns (negative-control-b.log), and :227 fails if the refusal keys on the schema record instead of the table shape.
justifications.evidence: logs/after-suite.log records 66 passed with EXIT=0 at revision c96bcbd374 and logs/negative-control-a.log, -b.log and -c.log each record a single failing test, but the base arm for the new test file, logs/base-new-tests.log, ran a six-test draft that names run_store.UnreadableRunStore rather than the eight-test delivered file.
justifications.fit: reckon/run_store.py:172 declares UnreadableRunStoreError(RuntimeError), the same base class as the RuntimeError refusal it replaces, in the module-level helper and docstring idiom the surrounding functions use.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/run_store.py:692 stored_run_rows raises UnreadableRunStoreError through _unreadable for a damaged file, a failed archive attach and a payloadless runs table, and reckon/run_store.py:1648 indexed_run_ids raises it too, so a ledger read refuses rather than answering an empty population.
justifications.reuse: reckon/run_store.py:372 _record_rows is the module's single record join, and both RunStore._indexed_records at :1207 and stored_run_rows at :713 call it; the exception refines main's existing RuntimeError refusal rather than adding a second reader.
justifications.scope_discipline: the node's seven commits touch only reckon/run_store.py, tests/test_an_unreadable_store_is_an_error.py and docs/evidence/fragments/history-persists-as-detail-washes-out/unreadable-store-is-an-error-s29.html, all inside its four declared write paths, and its only reckon/ledger.py edit is a docstring the main merge dropped rather than a scope breach.
